## Acceptance criteria
1. A 7-day simulated diary (seeded test data) renders correctly: budget, trend, heatmaps.
2. Food search returns results <50 ms for 1k items on the emulator (FTS5).
3. Weigh-in twice in one day → both events stored; trend chart unchanged by intra-day
   noise; smoothing switchable with documented math screens.
4. Every deep link in the IA registry resolves (real screen or documented stub).

text: **M3 implementation complete — 2026-09-12.** Acceptance criteria: (1) 7-day simulated diary (DiarySeeder + in-test SeedingRobot) renders correctly — budget/trend/heatmap asserted in `M3DiaryHubTest`; heatmap is THE shared R-D4 component (viridis ramp, month-paginated), placed on the Hub diary-slice card (FLAGGED: DESIGN-SYSTEM §7.1 assigns heatmap ownership to F05/F09/F11; F10 spec silent). (2) FTS5 search: 1,000 foods, 12-query set on the API 29 emulator — median 0.64 ms, p95 2.8 ms, max 3.2 ms (~80× under the 50 ms budget); `@Fts5` verified on BundledSQLiteDriver; contentful FTS table (external-content impossible: TEXT PK), input sanitized, exact matches promoted. (3) Weigh-in twice/day → both events stored verbatim; trend unchanged by intra-day noise (asserted); smoothing switchable (EWMA/zero-phase/MA-7) with `MathDocsScreen` documenting each formula + formulaVersion; α tuner defaults 0.15 (R-A2). (4) Full IA deep-link registry resolves — typed `REGISTRY`, unit-pinned; 14 documented stubs for later milestones; registry additions `wlo://diary`, `wlo://log/search` FLAGGED for IA.md owner. (5) Corrections visible per entry — diary_entry_revisions append-only audit + provenance/revision sheet. Tests: 22/22 instrumented (two consecutive passes), all JVM suites green, D1–D7+D9 clean. Schema stayed v4 (audit tables added in A; day-status persistence deferred to v5 — FLAGGED). Vico skipped (signature charts are Canvas per DESIGN-SYSTEM §6) — FLAGGED.
